h1: Double Tank Deep Fryer with Two Baskets for Chips and Chicken
short_description: Chips, chicken, samosas and fish all sell better when they come out hot and crisp. This double tank deep fryer has two separate oil tanks and two wire baskets, so you can fry two different foods at the same time without mixing flavours. A stainless steel body and stand make it strong, hygienic and easy to clean for restaurants, fast food outlets, hotels and snack bars. Kenyan chips sellers search for it as an electric deep fryer price in Kenya or a deep fryer.

sections.heading: Key Features and Benefits
sections.body:
Two separate tanks. Fry chips in one tank and chicken or fish in the other, with no flavour transfer. You serve more customers during rush hour.

Two wire baskets. Long handled baskets lift the food out in one go and drain oil quickly, so food is crisp, not greasy.

Stainless steel tanks and body. Stainless steel resists rust and oil stains and is easy to degrease. It lasts longer than painted steel.

Control knobs. Knobs at the back let you set the heat for each tank, so you cook at the right temperature for each food.

Strong stand with lower shelf. The frame holds the fryer at a comfortable height, and the shelf stores baskets, oil tins and tools.

sections.heading: Who It Suits
sections.body: Fast food outlets, chips and chicken restaurants, hotels, bars, school and hospital canteens, bakeries and caterers that fry snacks.

sections.heading: What to Check Before Buying
sections.body: Confirm whether you need a gas or electric model and the tank size for your volume. Place the fryer under a hood with good ventilation, and keep a fire blanket nearby.

sections.heading: Care and Maintenance
sections.body: Filter the oil daily and change it when it darkens. Clean the tanks and baskets when the oil is cool, and never leave a hot fryer unattended.

sections.heading: In Practice
sections.body: Frying is the busiest and most dangerous station, so give the fryer space. Heat the oil slowly to the right temperature, do not overfill the baskets, and let chips drain over the tank for a few seconds before serving. Filter the oil daily, replace it before it smokes and never add water to hot oil.
